review_policy.observed_slots: Only accepted structured semantic state or workflow settings; capability prose/missing-action labels alone are not typed slot extraction evidence. This is the same structural-slot scope applied to the C review.
review_policy.intent: Judge the requested work and unsupported action from accepted interpretation and preserved conversation separately from the slot representation.
review_policy.questions: One label per actual pending/draft clarification question. Tool-gap recovery choices are not missing-condition questions and do not imply action execution.
review_policy.whole_request_success: Requires correct UNSUPPORTED routing and catalogue-based reason, preserved requested meaning, no unsupported assumptions, no unrequested replacement work. Does not imply external execution.
review_policy.holdout: U03 is evaluation only; no repair instruction is inferred from its wording.
